{{BossList|Freeze = Show|Stun = Show|Toxic Gunner = Show|Ref = Only first '''Demon''' spawned as a boss.}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Unholy Martyrdom}}''' - Spawns seven [[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sin]]s upon death. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Demon''' was the second boss that appeared in the second act of the [[Lunar Overture Event]], though only the first '''Demon''' that spawned considered as a [[Boss]]. It was a high-health enemy with decent speed and multiple immunities, such as [[Burn Immunity|Burn]] and [[Stun Immunity|Stun]] immunities. While it was a boss enemy, it was also immune to being frozen by freezing towers and being slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], as well as 35% defense. The '''Demon''' had one ability, where upon death it would kneel down and disintegrate, spawning seven [[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sin]]s. The '''Demon''' could also be spawned by the [[Reaper (Lunar Overture)|Reaper]], however, the '''Demon''' spawned had reduced health and a faster speed. ==Apperance== The '''Demon''' was a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It had a red skin tone and a dark red torso, waist, legs and a pair of wings made of magma. It had muscular arms and reddish-black horns with red stripes on its head. The '''Demon''' had a death animation where it would kneel and reach for the sky before flashing red and turning into ash, with its body then disassembling and fading away. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]] are very useful against this. **High DPS towers with the ability to hit multiple enemies at once, like the [[Pursuit]] or [[Ranger]] can hit multiple [[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sins]] that the '''Demon''' spawns on death at once, making it more effective against it. **The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be useful at boosting their firerate and range respectively. *Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]] or [[Executioner]] can be useful at clearing out the [[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sin]]s spawned by the '''Demon''' upon its death. *Defense dropping towers, like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Freezer]] can be useful at decreasing the '''Demon's''' defense, though it is not necessary as they decrease its defense by a minimal amount. **The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Golden Pyromancer]] should not be used as the '''Demon''' has [[Burn Immunity]], meaning that it cannot be set on fire nor have its [[Defense]] reduced. *When it first spawns on Wave 14, it is a boss enemy, therefore it cannot be frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]] or completely stopped by the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]]. **This also means that it is unaffected by the [[Witch (Lunar Overture)|Witch]]'s ability. **After Wave 14, the '''Demon''' is no longer a boss, reducing its immunities to only being immune to the [[Warden]]'s and [[Electroshocker]]'s stun, only being slowed down by them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} DemonWalk.gif|Walking animation (31 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) DemonDeath.gif|Death animation (31 October 2023 – 21 December 2023) {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Act 2 Cutscene|'''Demon''' in the [[The Haunted Past]] cutscene. }} ==Trivia== *The amount of [[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sin]]s spawned by the '''Demon''' upon death is a reference to the [[wp:Seven deadly sins|seven deadly sins]]. *When the '''Demon''' was spawned by the [[Reaper (Lunar Overture)|Reaper]], the [[Sin (Lunar Overture)|Sin]]s that it spawned did not have their health decreased, making them have more health in total than the '''Demon'''. ==Update History== *'''31 October
